description: List the validators of the Celestia Fibre network with Cumulo's measurements: whether each registered a Fibre host and is ready, stake rank and share, typical round trip, uptime over 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, and where the host runs (country, hosting provider). Mocha testnet (mocha-5). Filter by registered or not, status, name, country or provider; sort by stake, latency, uptime or name. From a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes of an open API by Cumulo, credited in each answer. Validator names and hosts are typed by the validators and marked untrusted. Use get_fibre_validator for one validator with its signing record, data retention, probes and diagnosis.

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)

country.description: Two-letter country code of the host, e.g. DE

provider.description: Part of the hosting provider name, e.g. hetzner

registered.description: registered = has a Fibre host on chain; not_registered = still has none

sort.description: stake = largest first; latency = fastest first; uptime_* = best first; name = A-Z

status.description: Cumulo status of the host, e.g. online or no_host; the answer lists the statuses present

name: list_fibre_validators
